book.title: Babam la omirong Paulo me mai ekelesiap onim Rom

content: Bualam neip buo aun Morowa gare kamniap

Are ratmat ga ekelesiap papap tuam, managirung mirie pagap ganam la makosarong Morowa ira buo na ubonuvarap ang. Are ratmat ga mariktung maranit me milam gare ro, Temiala aun Morowa gare kamniap ula inim. Tale are kamniap ula ivara. Karuk. Mimaning ka ninimiap, are ratmat le akosarming tavuk la naong Morowa aime ga tavuk ila babai. Okosarming are tiro ga eba lotuming migat me ai Morowa.

Ga buat amiuluan tavuk maiang inamaniap onim na uro kimanam la tale lotumeng o migat me ai Morowa. Karuk. Ebun mimerana ga mamiuluan. Pa miairang Morowa meba origiang agat ming meba betieng ga nou ba ga tavuk ming eba betang ga non ara. Leba are ba rie, tubiat la puoming meba arakiming tavuk ila mumuri ga tavuk la naong Morowa aime, ga tavuk ila puvuvui migat na irap a Morowa.
Okosarbuong ubi o kamniap la ualo Morowa buun

Tie, na ubonuvarap ang Morowa la tovuvuoong ga bettung gare Apostolo. Are ratmat ga tuga miralava narit narit gare ro, Buat makanirming bop mi agarit ga mimama mimi kan la natauanming migat. Pa maset teagatming ume nagan ming ula mamaranu la ualo Morowa miun.
Memani, bira neip buo la ame papot napup. Talet namurit nap. Ga napup ganam ma neip la talet okosarmeng namurit ubi. Ubimeng iat meba magamelie neip meba maionang maset.

Are gat to, bubuo la bupapot ma inamaniap ga bume makosar non ara non ara ubiap. Pa bubuo narit narit la naganbuong ira Karisito, ga betbuong gare namurit it neip. Ga bubuo narit narit la nebupam ira ma mirie non napup ma namurit it neip. Are ratmat ga buat agatbuong nap ba ma neip la makurupin non napup ma neip. Karuk.
Eva, abit Morowa la bubouvara ga bukami o non ara non ara kamniap meba okosarbuong ubi ang. Leba ame noba la amaning kamniap o ties o unuli ang Morowa, okosarang it iro nagan la uario.

Leba ame noba la amaning kamniap o uaganuliap ma ekelesiap papap, tie okosarang ubi migat o uaganuliap ma papap. Leba ame noba la amaning kamniap o ubi o usingnualap, tie okosarang migat ubi o usingnualap.

Leba ame noba la amaning kamniap o unimuap o nagan maiong ekelesiap meba ameuluan Karisito, okosarmeng migat urie ubi ga meimum nagan maiong. Leba ame noba la ume ualam pagap maun papap mila baim, tie alam papaluaip maun. Leba ame noba la amaning kamniap o nukeiap, dalap a le temaiara migat me urie ubi ga ubiang maranit. Leba ame noba la ume kadik maime teip ga magaulap la ame kiribas, tie teaba ga okosarang urie ubi.
Nabuong migat maime papap ganam kabirana buo
Leba naming maime papap mim, naming maset migat maime. Mialam ibup mi ira ma tavukup mila kiram ga parepming migat ira ma tavukup mila murum.
Naming maset maime ekelesiap papap mim. Mimi narit narit le temiara dalap mi migat ga man miavim it bop ma mirie non inamaniap gat.
Ubiming maranit me ai Ila Kakani ga buat palalaming. Pa miairang Muranama Ila Babai meba ira na dalap mi.
Temiba maset na tara la mime auanmila Ila Kakani un nagan meba miagaalie. Leba betieng giginanim ira mi, dusming maranit puoieng na tara la miolai giginanim. Ga marikming mar mirie lap ganam.
Leba ima noba ma inamaniap am Morowa la kagesmeng ma pagap ba, eva magamilie ma pagap mim. Ga maagamilie inamaniap ba mila kibangam la betmeng mi.
Marikming me ai Morowa ga amikang meba malaminaisang inamaniap la akosarmeng tavuk ila kire ira mi ga eba mikirarameng. Eva, amikang Morowa meba maagaalie, pa buat makaranming.
Leba temeba inamaniap, temiba ga mirie. Leba giginam ba dalap ma ga meliba, eva miliba iat ga mirie.

Dalap mi le narit ba ga mirie ganam, ga miaring narit agat. Buat teagatming meba mikakanim ba ga ame bop. Karuk. Pa temiba meba mionang un namurit dalap ga inamaniap la tale memaning bop mila kanim. Buat agatming na dalap mi gare ro, “Turuot la mating agat ula muru pa non teip ga magaulap la karuk.”
Leba akosarmeng inamaniap tavuk ila kire ira mi, eva, buat mipulo a tavuk ila kire me maun. Karuk. Akosarming tavuk ila mumuri ira ma iat mirier inamaniap ganam.
Leba puoming, tie mimamaranim ba le mionang un malina iat ga mirier inamaniap ganam. Mimi kan la buat agatming me danunumiap.
Migap tuam migat, mimi kan la buat mipulo kiribas la okosarmeng inamaniap ira mi. Miairang Morowa eba bukbukang maime ga eba apulang me maun. Memani, Ila Kakani la ugama:

content.text: “Tavuk o unupulap o kiribas, urie la ubi rung. Turuo kan la eba tapulang uniap ula kiro me maun.”

content: Are ratmat ga mumuru meba okosarming gare Babam ula puaru la tiesieng gare ro: “Karorap mim leba tafameng me parak, tie makamming parak. Leba mema tapmaio, mialang burunam maun. Leba okosarming gare tiruo, eba mulimeba migat me tavuk ila kire la akosarmeng ira mi.”
Buat miaira tavuk ila kire meba mikurupeling. Karuk. Akosarming tavuk ila muri meba iniang tavuk ila kire.
